en.artifactAutoNote: ${n} file(s) will move to quarantine on delete
en.artifactAutoOnly: Produced files move to quarantine automatically; they are not listed here.
en.artifactModifiedWarn: Pre-existing files it changed (unticked by default):
en.artifactTruncated: The list was truncated; anything unlisted is left alone.
en.busy: This session is currently open in DSH; the delete did not complete. Try again in a moment (usually a few seconds), or restart DSH and retry.
en.childrenHint: This conversation has {n} child sessions (subagents). Ticked ones are deleted too.
en.descPermanent: This permanently deletes the session and all of its conversation records (log, workspace accounting and statistics). This cannot be undone.
en.descRecycle: This removes the session and all of its conversation records (log, workspace accounting and statistics) from the list and puts them in the system trash.
en.doneQuarantine: Session deleted, ${n} file(s) moved to quarantine
en.notFound: Session not found (it may already be deleted).
en.pageArtifactsAuto: Send produced files straight to quarantine
en.pageHintArtifactsAsk: Deleting a session lists the files and lets you tick what to move.
en.pageHintArtifactsAuto: Every file in the scope below moves to quarantine without asking.
en.pageHintArtifactsOff: Deleting a session clears its record only and never touches files in the working directory.
en.pageHintArtifactsOn: Deleting a session also handles the files this conversation touched in its working directory.
en.pageHintAsk: Show a confirmation dialog before every session delete.
en.pageHintAuto: Delete the session right away without asking.
en.pageHintAutoWithArtifacts: A delete still opens a dialog, because the produced-file list has to be shown first.
en.pageRecycleOff: The session is removed from the disk right away and cannot be restored.
en.pageRecycleOn: The session goes to the system trash and can be restored.
en.pageRootCustomHint: The quarantine folder is created here, one timestamped subfolder per delete
en.pageRootPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the default path
en.pageScopeAllHint: Also includes pre-existing files this conversation rewrote — moving them changes what was already in the working directory.
en.pageScopeCreatedHint: Touches only files this conversation created; files it merely edited are never moved.
en.pageSkipGit: Skip files inside a git repository
en.pageSkipGitOff: Repository files move into quarantine too — deleting a conversation that worked in a project can carry the project source away.
en.pageSkipGitOn: Only files outside git repositories are handled; code inside a repository is never moved.
en.pageSyncChildrenOff: When off, the dialog lists the child sessions and you tick the ones to delete.
en.pageSyncChildrenOn: A delete also removes the subagent sessions it spawned.
en.pickerOpening: The system folder dialog is open; pick a folder in that window
en.pickerTruncated: Too many subfolders: only the first 500 are listed
en.starAsk: ⭐ A star would make the author's day
en.title: Delete session
